Fist of Bane Volgu Drak is human follower of  Bane, He is next to a ledge on the second floor of Felogyr's Fireworks in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.
“
I like trespassers -- I like the sounds they make when I break their bones.
„
— Volgu Drak, when spoken to, initiating combat

Involvement

Volgu Drak is on the second floor of Felogyr's Fireworks.

The second floor of Felogyr's Fireworks is considered a restricted area, so he and other laboratory workers and guards such as  Fist of Bane Hyrriet and  Limeburn Sphagwood immediately become hostile upon seeing any party member there, or if he is spoken to. Also, he joins the fight as soon as he notices any commotion, siding with other followers of  Bane.
